choice.basis: The chart shows a significant decline in the reservoir storage level index from 23.9 in 2005 to 10.1 in 2014, indicating a substantial change over the full period. The public task requires determining whether this full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, and the chart evidence supports a substantial change due to the magnitude of the decline.
choice.option_label: Route the 2005 to 2014 reservoir storage change to substantial-change follow-up
